chunks: They will have no protectors to help them other than God. He whom God allows to go astray has no way.
ai.seo_question: Who are the allies of those God sends astray?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah by negating the efficacy of false deities or intercessors for the misguided, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in both essence and action. It highlights that divine misguidance is a consequence of human choice, leaving the astray without any protective ally (Wali) other than God Himself, who ultimately judges their state. This serves as a reminder that salvation depends on aligning with divine will rather than relying on created intermediaries.
